svg.title: Engineering pulse — real project commits
svg.desc: 1015 commits across five public projects, 72 active days, peak 114 commits per day. 2026-08-16 through 2026-11-07 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-11-07T00:30:35.666Z.
